module.name: prefer-object-spread
module.description: Report empty-target Object.assign patterns for manual review without rewriting value semantics.

scenarios.name: should allow explicit object spread and non-empty assignment targets
scenarios.given: an object spread or Object.assign(target, source)

scenarios.name: should report empty-target Object.assign without autofix
scenarios.then: a preferObjectSpread violation is reported without rewriting the call

scenarios.name: should preserve getter copying semantics
scenarios.then: the call is reported without an autofix that would preserve the getter

scenarios.name: should preserve prototype behavior from special keys
scenarios.given: Object.assign({}, JSON.parse(source)) where source may contain __proto__
scenarios.then: the call is reported without an autofix that changes prototype behavior

scenarios.name: should allow spread arguments that need manual handling
